Game Overview

Air Race is a arcade game built around race through the skies in Air Race, where sharp reflexes and quick maneuvers are your best allies. Steer clear of oncoming traffic and collect coins to boost your score, as the excitement builds with each passing second. How far can you soar before getting caught in the frenzy?
